lines.en: All right, Mr. Geller, right this way.
So, how dark do you want to be?
We have one, two, or three.
Well, I like how you look. What are you?
Puerto Rican. Two. I think a two.
You're going to face the red light.
When the red light goes on, the spring's about to start,
When the spring stops, count to five.
Pat yourself down to avoid drip marks,
then turn around so we can get your back.
Got it? Spray, count, pat, and turn.
Well, I have a Ph.D., so...
Wait, wait! I'm not... I'm not finished counting!
No! I barely even got the three Mississippi!
Mississippi? I said count to five!
Not that bad yet, but it keeps getting darker for the next four hours.
So, how dark is it gonna get?
Well, you got sprayed with two twos and...
Yeah, but your back's a zero.
You're gonna want to even that out.
You might want to get back in there.
Wait... wait a minute, there's no light on the back wall.
How do I know when it's gonna start?
I went to that tanning place your wife suggested.
You can do a duet of Ebony and Ivory all by yourself.
How could you mess this up?
You go into the booth, you count to five, and you turn around.
How do you count to five?
Now, let me explain how this works.
You go into the booth and you face the rest...
I'm gonna stop you right there, Glenda.
Does it look like this is my first time, huh?
Now, I want four twos, and I want 'em all on my back.
I don't want to see anybody.
I went to the tanning place and the same thing happened to me.
You have to let me in.
I just had to get a picture of this.
